name: Ecomax, Inc.
summary: Presently, Ecomax, Inc. maintains no substantial operational footprint. The company's strategic focus involves identifying fresh business prospects or pursuing a merger or acquisition with an unspecified firm. In its prior incarnation, it specialized in a wet-cleaning process, presenting an alternative solution to traditional dry-cleaning methods. Formally known as Ecomat, Inc. until May 2021, the entity then adopted its current designation, Ecomax, Inc. This New York City-based corporation was established in 1995 and functions as a subsidiary of Clark Orient (BVI) Limited.
